csta.ibm.pong

Class PhantomPowerUp

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • java.awt.Container
        • javax.swing.JComponent
          • csta.ibm.pong.GameObject
            • csta.ibm.pong.PhantomPowerUp
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable

    public class PhantomPowerUp
extends csta.ibm.pong.GameObject

    the PhantomPowerUp class represents the entities that spawns phantom balls when a normal ball collides with it. The hitbox of the power up object is triggered by its visibility

    2026-11-12

    • Method Detail

      • setPossibleZone

        public void setPossibleZone(int lowX,
                            int lowY,
                            int highX,
                            int highY)
        Setter method to set the possible zone for the power up to appear. The power up will appear at a random location within the specified zone when it is not visible. The zone is defined by the lowest and highest x and y coordinates.
        Parameters:
        lowX - the lowest x coordinate of the zone
        lowY - the lowest y coordinate of the zone
        highX - the highest x coordinate of the zone
        highY - the highest y coordinate of the zone

      • setImg

        Parameters:

      • spawnPhantom

        public Ball spawnPhantom(Ball triggerBall)
        Add a ball phantom to the game. The phantom will bounce off the paddles once and then disappear. The phantom should have same attributes as the trigger ball except that phantom's dx is smaller than the ball's, and opposite dy comparing to the trigger ball
        Parameters:
        triggerBall - the ball who triggers this power up (Should be the main ball)
        Returns:
        the phantom generated
